meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进项目、注册并装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再引导你填 Resend 凭据,最后用邮件给你发一封 hello。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道时触发;需要你先在 Resend 建账号、验证发送域名并创建 API Key 与 webhook。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件渠道接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建测试

say.text: 我的邮箱是 me@example.com,让 agent 用邮件回我
say.note: 会把你注册为 owner 并发一封 hello 邮件

say.text: 跑一下 resend-registration 测试,看适配器有没有漂移
say.note: 测试变红说明导入行或依赖出了问题

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude copies the Resend email adapter into your project, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned adapter package, builds and runs the registration test, then walks you through Resend credentials and emails you a hello.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw. You must first create a Resend account, verify a sending domain, and make an API key and webhook.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds, runs the test

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com - have the agent reply by email
say_en.note: Registers you as owner and sends a hello email

say_en.text: Run the resend-registration test to check the adapter
say_en.note: Red means the import line or install drifted
